summary: Iteration 155: Acronis Backup Actions (Run, Cancel, Apply Plan, Policies) - All 25 backend tests passed. Frontend verified: Orphans tab with Apply Plan buttons (89), checkboxes (89), bulk action button, ChangePlanDialog with all data-testids (targets, search, runnow, confirm) and 98 plan options. Live tab shows 'No backups running' (Cancel button N/A). Acronis Console tab has amber info banner about API limitations.

minor.issue: Returns 400 with Acronis error message instead of validation error when policy_id missing but resource_ids provided (acceptable - Acronis service validates)
Returns error object without 'count' field when Acronis rejects invalid UUID format (acceptable - graceful degradation)

issues: Time column shows 'Invalid Date' for some backup jobs - known issue from iteration 154

critical_code_review_comments: All new Acronis backup action endpoints working correctly:
- POST /api/acronis/backup/run: Validates required fields (policy_id, resource_ids), returns 400 on missing
- POST /api/acronis/backup/cancel: Validates required fields, returns {status: 'cancelled', resource_count}
- GET /api/acronis/policies: Returns 98 real backup policies with correct structure (id, name, type starting with policy.backup.)
- POST /api/acronis/policies/apply: Returns {status, applied_count, total, results, run_result}
- GET /api/acronis/resources/{id}/applications: Returns items array with application details
- GET /api/acronis/live-activities: Now includes resource_id and policy_id fields for Cancel button

Frontend data-testids all present: tab-dashboard, tab-live, tab-acronis, tab-orphans, tab-compliance, tab-verify, run-orphan-scan-btn, apply-plan-{id}, orphan-select-{id}, apply-plan-bulk-btn, apply-plan-targets, apply-plan-search, apply-plan-runnow, apply-plan-confirm, apply-plan-option-{id}
Amber info banner correctly explains Acronis API limitations (no Pause/Resume, no per-run scheduling)
seed_data_creation: None - uses live Acronis API data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backup Center at /backup-center has 6 tabs. Orphans tab: Run Scan button triggers live Acronis scan (~10s), returns ~89 unprotected resources with Apply Plan buttons and checkboxes. Selecting checkboxes shows bulk action button. ChangePlanDialog: opens with target chips, search bar, 98 plan options, run-now checkbox, Apply button. Live tab: shows running backups with Cancel button (when policy_id and resource_id present) - currently 0 running. Acronis Console tab: amber banner explains API limitations. All new endpoints tested: /api/acronis/backup/run, /api/acronis/backup/cancel, /api/acronis/policies, /api/acronis/policies/apply, /api/acronis/applications/{id}, /api/acronis/resources/{id}/applications.
